title: Match countries to capitals: Europe
intro: Match each capital city with its country in Europe.

pairs.explain: Sofia is the capital of Bulgaria.
Helsinki is the capital of Finland.
Rome is the capital of Italy.
Vilnius is the capital of Lithuania.
Chișinău is the capital of Republic of Moldova.
Skopje is the capital of North Macedonia.
Bucharest is the capital of Romania.
Bratislava is the capital of Slovakia.
